visual_identity.core_identity: A colossal subterranean worm whose immense segmented body and circular tooth-filled maw communicates overwhelming subterranean scale.
visual_identity.silhouette: Huge cylindrical segmented body emerging through earth or rock, front dominated by a round open maw.
visual_identity.head_features: No separate skull; front is a circular muscular mouth ringed with inward-pointing teeth.
visual_identity.body_shape: Extremely thick worm body with repeated broad segments and a long continuation beyond the visible composition.
visual_identity.surface: Large simple segmented plates or folds; minimal fine texture.
visual_identity.limb_structure: No arms, legs, fins, wings, or external walking appendages. The body is one enormous continuous segmented cylinder ending anteriorly in a circular tooth-ringed maw.
visual_identity.shape_lock: Draw one colossal limbless segmented worm: a huge cylindrical body with broad repeated segments and one circular front maw ringed with inward-pointing teeth. There is no separate skull, snake face, dragon head, eye-bearing head, or limb of any kind.

accuracy_checks: gargantuan scale is obvious from relative scale cues

reference.notes: Reference material controls creature identity, anatomy, and silhouette only; Black-Ink controls the final coloring-book rendering style.

description: A colossal subterranean worm whose immense segmented body and circular tooth-filled maw communicates overwhelming subterranean scale. Extremely thick worm body with repeated broad segments and a long continuation beyond the visible composition. Large simple segmented plates or folds; minimal fine texture.

scene_identity.size_impression: Gargantuan limbless subterranean worm whose visible body thickness and tunnel scale make it overwhelming without inventing a dragon head.
scene_identity.natural_posture: Continuous segmented cylinder fills and contacts the tunnel route; the circular maw leads the movement while most body mass continues behind.

known_failure_modes.symptom: front becomes a dragon, snake, or animal skull
known_failure_modes.correction: remove separate skull/face and restore one circular muscular tooth-ringed maw at the end of the cylinder

known_failure_modes.symptom: legs, fins, wings, or arms appear
known_failure_modes.correction: remove all appendages; body is one continuous limbless segmented cylinder
